written.headline: SEBI to issue guidelines for AI use and human oversight in capital markets
written.summary: SEBI will soon issue guidelines requiring market firms to disclose AI usage and maintain human oversight over critical decisions, according to SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey. The upcoming framework aims to protect investors and maintain market integrity without compromising safety.

written.headline: Indonesian police raided Nvidia partner Megaspeed local unit in early 2026
written.summary: Indonesian police raided the office of Nvidia partner Megaspeed's local subsidiary in early 2026 at the request of U.S. authorities. Officers found unopened server racks but no graphics processing units during the FBI-requested inquiry.

written.headline: Mount Thor raises $45 million to build cloud infrastructure on Apple silicon
written.summary: Mount Thor raised $45 million across seed and Series A rounds to build cloud infrastructure for agentic AI on Apple silicon. The startup provides Mac data-center compute instances for macOS workloads.

written.headline: Zus Health raises $33M Series B to build healthcare AI data platform
written.summary: Zus Health raised $33 million in Series B funding led by Drive Capital to build data infrastructure for AI-powered clinical workflows. The financing brings the company's total funding to more than $100 million.

written.headline: Sumary raises $25M seed round to expand AI accounting software in Europe
written.summary: Copenhagen-based AI accounting software startup Sumary has raised $25M in a seed round led by Singular, bringing its total funding to $29.2M. The company plans to use the capital to expand across Europe and establish a commercial hub in London.
